summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of the 'Empresa → Tendencias' duplicate-warning feature in ThesisResult.jsx. All 5 specified tests PASSED (load, duplicate-warning rendering, generate-thesis button on cyber trend, add-company click flow, unauthenticated /thesis page load).
critical_code_review_comments: ThesisResult.jsx is ~480 lines and starts to mix many concerns (CompanyCard, TrendCard, StageRow, ContraSection, SourcesList, TamScoreBadge). Consider splitting into separate files for future maintainability, even though it is not strictly >700 lines today.

trend-add data-testid is built from the first 16 chars of the trend name slug (`_norm(t.name).slice(0,16)`). Two distinct trends sharing the same 16-char prefix would collide and produce duplicate keys + testids. Low risk but worth noting.
thesisLinkSuggestions does 1 LLM call on every load of a company thesis; consider caching server-side keyed on (company_thesis_id, trend signature) to avoid repeating cost on refresh.
test_credentials: Cookie session_token=test_profile_token_fixed_123 on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host (user_id=test_profile_user_123). Seeded via seed_profile_test.py + seed_company_thesis_test.py.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Verified that pre-seeded thesis_test_company_msft (MSFT) and thesis_test_aidc are present and the duplicate matcher correctly returns to_add for 'Inteligencia artificial y centros de datos' and to_create for 'Ciberseguridad empresarial'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test 4 mutates state: it calls POST /api/thesis/thesis_test_aidc/add-company which adds MSFT to that trend thesis. Re-running test 4 will be idempotent in the UI (the button still transitions to 'Añadida'), but the underlying thesis_test_aidc now contains MSFT in addition to NVDA. Re-seed with seed_profile_test.py if a clean state is needed before re-testing.
